description.value: Science World is Vancouver's iconic science museum housed in a striking geodesic dome on the False Creek waterfront, operated as a charitable non-profit focused on STEAM education. Visitors explore interactive, hands-on exhibits and galleries designed to spark curiosity across all ages. The museum actively engages with the cycling community, hosting Go By Bike Week events and situated along one of Vancouver's most popular waterfront cycling corridors.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (5 spaces) at 89m. Total: 5 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Science World is open and publicly operating at 1455 Quebec Street, Vancouver, with phone 604.443.7440 and address matching OSM tags exactly. The fetched content does not mention bike parking, washrooms, water refill, café, or any other cyclist-specific amenities explicitly, so those fields remain null per the evidence rules. Notably, the website advertises a 'Go By Bike Week – Free events!' listing on June 05, indicating cyclist-friendly programming, but this does not constitute confirmed year-round amenity evidence.
concerns: OSM note flags that the legal name is 'TELUS World of Science' (OSM official_name) while 'Science World' is the colloquial and website-preferred name — the listing uses 'Science World' consistently with OSM name field and the website.
Car parking lots are noted on the website as closed on Vancouver 2026 World Cup match days; no information about bike parking availability on those days.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Science World is a well-known, publicly accessible, operating science museum and a natural stop for touring cyclists on the False Creek waterfront. No grounds for exclusion.
